question: You decided fix_pass_volume (flow-005, blind, 0.85) and required: direct-side long passes 50-90 per match and short escapes at least 20%. Here is the result. Accept, revise or investigate?

criteria.absolute: Direct side long passes 50-90 per match.
criteria.escapes: Short escapes at least 20% of pressed build-ups.
criteria.regression: All suites pass (owner rule, always required).

evidence.rootCause: Pass volume was high because the ball was in play 90 of 95 minutes (real 55-58): restarts took 3-10 s and the ball rarely left the pitch (13 throw-ins, 3.5 corners per match; real about 40-45 and 10). Passing itself was realistic: average ground pass 16 m (real about 18), time on the ball 1.0-1.4 s.
evidence.implementation: Real restart times (throw-in 15 s, goal kick 24 s, corner 28 s, free kick 18/30 s, penalty 50 s, goal celebration 35 s); tackles and interceptions deflect the ball properly; crosses can be blocked behind for corners; a pressed defender on the touchline can put it out.
evidence.rejectedLever: Slower decisions (time on the ball) cut passes further but collapse short escapes (17% -> 6% at touch 1.7) and goals, because pressers arrive first. Not used.

leagueCheck60Matches.note: shots and corners were already low before this change (PR #40 baseline: shots 15.4, goals 2.33)

evidence.analysis: Ball-in-play time and pass volume moved strongly towards real football and escapes improved (13% -> 17%), but both required criteria still fail. The ball is still in play about 72 minutes because the ball leaves the pitch less often than in real matches (21 throw-ins v about 40-45). The pressing side still has 1272 passes at 65% possession. The direct side's long passes (155) would need its total passes near 350-400 to reach 50-90 at a realistic 20-25% share.
